name: National Building and Marketing Co.
summary: National Building and Marketing Co. engages in the wholesale and retail trade of construction materials in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers a wide range of products, including ordinary and film-faced plywood, timber wood, scaffolding boards, wood blankets, rebar fabrication, wire mesh, rebar steel, epoxy steel bars, steel props, double couplers, scaffold caster wheels, shuttering clamps, water stops, PVC water stop splicing, backup rods, Sika-Flex sealant, saafseal, wheel spacers, chair and clip spacers, PVC pipes and cones, block reinforcement mesh, Hy-Rib lath, Rib-Lath, block ladder mesh, corrugated angles, nylon rolls, protection boards, geotextile fabric, and fiber mesh. …
